title: Revise makes every AI writing edit visible and optional
friendlyTitle: Revise lets writers see and choose every AI edit
summary: Revise is an AI editor for long-form writing that presents suggestions as tracked changes, supports custom style rules and voice profiles, and lets users choose editing intensity. It also offers in-document chat, speech-to-text and a browser extension; its performance and privacy claims are vendor-reported.
friendlySummary: The editor suggests changes without silently replacing the original text. Writers can set style rules, choose how strong the edit should be and accept or reject each change.
whyItMatters: The useful design choice is not another promise to ‘write like you,’ but making every change inspectable and reversible. Writers evaluating AI editors should test whether voice survives across a full manuscript, review data handling and retain versioned originals before accepting broad rewrites.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Visible changes make it easier to keep your own voice and catch bad edits. Save the original and check the privacy rules before uploading a full manuscript.
